topic: Evidence of Continental Drift and Seafloor Spreading
key_concepts: Rock formations in Africa line up with those in South America
Fossils found in rocks support continental drift
Glossopteris fossils occur in both India and Antarctica
Coal deposits form from compacted and decomposed swamp plants
Coal deposits are found in South America, Africa, India, Southeast Asia, and Antarctica
Antarctica must have once been located where life could be supported
Seafloor spreading was proposed by Harry Hess and Robert Dietz
Hot less dense material rises at mid-ocean ridges and forms new seafloor
Earth's magnetic field is a dipole generated in the molten outer core
Magnetic reversal happens when the north and south magnetic poles flip
Magnetic patterns in ocean floor rocks record past magnetic reversals
Convection currents in the mantle drive tectonic plate movement
